t: You're looking at Unfurl, a sculpture by Eilis O'Connell. She's an Irish sculptor, and she made this piece. The title suggests something opening out, so take a moment to walk around it and see how its form changes as you move. I don't have more detail on its materials or history, so let the work speak for itself. Look at the shapes, the surface and the way it sits in its surroundings, and see what it makes you think of.
